security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: icon: http://icon.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost icon: http://icon.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Disk cleaner, app uninstaller and terminal spaces
bundle.longDescription: Clearspace is an all-in-one desktop app with Arc-style spaces. The Clean space finds what fills your disk and removes apps with everything they leave behind. The Terminal space keeps groups, colored tabs and startup commands, and brings every tab back after you quit or restart.
